name: Swift
on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  android:
    name: Android
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # os: ['ubuntu-24.04', 'macos-15-intel']
        os: ['ubuntu-24.04']
        android-sdk: ['nightly-6.3']
        android-api: ['28', '29', '31', '33']
        android-ndk: ['r27d']
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: skiptools/actions/setup-skip@v1
        with:
          gradle-version: 'none'
          install-swift-android-sdk: true
          swift-android-sdk-version: ${{ matrix.android-sdk }}
          swift-android-ndk-version: ${{ matrix.android-ndk }}

      - name: "Build Swift Package for Android (aarch64)"
        run: |
          ANDROID_SDK_VERSION=${{ matrix.android-api }} skip android build --arch aarch64 --android-api-level ${{ matrix.android-api }}

      - name: "Build Swift Package for Android (armv7)"
        run: |
          ANDROID_SDK_VERSION=${{ matrix.android-api }} skip android build --arch armv7 --android-api-level ${{ matrix.android-api }}

      - name: "Build Swift Package for Android (x86_64)"
        run: |
          ANDROID_SDK_VERSION=${{ matrix.android-api }} skip android build --arch x86_64 --android-api-level ${{ matrix.android-api }}

      - name: "Test Swift Package on Android"
        # can only lookup the current JavaVirtualMachine on API >= 31
        # https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-java/issues/419
        if: ${{ matrix.android-api >= 31 }}
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: ${{ matrix.android-api }}
          arch: x86_64
          script: |
            ANDROID_SDK_VERSION=${{ matrix.android-api }} skip android test --android-api-level ${{ matrix.android-api }} --apk --verbose

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
